provenance: The names, questions, outcome labels, and stories in this registry are site-side editorial: the chain stores none of them. Every number, phase, address, and refusal shown beside them is read from the chain.

6WZXJ7jBPPA3eFZPc8hQmmNsf3R4zAZN4DRZzfhc.title: SOL/USD range — the market you can trade
6WZXJ7jBPPA3eFZPc8hQmmNsf3R4zAZN4DRZzfhc.question: Where does the SOL/USD price finish this market's window — below $120, between $120 and $180, or above $180?
6WZXJ7jBPPA3eFZPc8hQmmNsf3R4zAZN4DRZzfhc.resolution: The question settles from Pyth's SOL/USD price feed, read over this market's answer window. A window the feed cannot answer resolves to the source-failure outcome instead — silence is an outcome here, not a stall.
6WZXJ7jBPPA3eFZPc8hQmmNsf3R4zAZN4DRZzfhc.story: Founded on 2026-08-30 and, so far as this deployment's history goes, the first market on it that can actually take a trade. Its trading capability was switched on inside the same session that founded it, well before the deadline that closed on every market before it, and three participants were admitted afterwards. It charges no fee on either side. Its collateral is a devnet test token, so nothing on this page is worth money. No trade has been made on it yet — when one is, this page reads it from the chain like everything else.

9JwhTHyxGhaoVsvSyT9VsJxV7PoQcPcjyhMLuJtY.title: SOL/USD range — the first market with a live capability root
9JwhTHyxGhaoVsvSyT9VsJxV7PoQcPcjyhMLuJtY.question: Where does the SOL/USD price finish this market's window — below $120, between $120 and $180, or above $180?
9JwhTHyxGhaoVsvSyT9VsJxV7PoQcPcjyhMLuJtY.resolution: The question settles from Pyth's SOL/USD price feed, read over this market's answer window. A window the feed cannot answer resolves to the source-failure outcome instead — silence is an outcome here, not a stall.
9JwhTHyxGhaoVsvSyT9VsJxV7PoQcPcjyhMLuJtY.story: The successor to the first public market, founded on 2026-08-30 to carry the one thing its predecessor was missing: a release that can switch trading on. Hours later it became the first market on any dClutch deployment to hold a live capability root — the account that has to exist before a single trade can be made — and the account is on devnet with the transaction that created it. It never traded. The cohort that followed widened the Core Market record by eight bytes, and this market's narrower record, intact and readable exactly as founding left it, is no longer a shape the deployed program will accept: it reached the same wall as the two markets before it, by a different road. Its successor was founded against the widened record and carries the trade.

7Mcu1ZT9KZBnvLZ2vhSvLeQMRA1ejQWD93yyPF2k.title: SOL/USD range — the first public market
7Mcu1ZT9KZBnvLZ2vhSvLeQMRA1ejQWD93yyPF2k.question: Where does the SOL/USD price finish this market's window — below $120, between $120 and $180, or above $180?
7Mcu1ZT9KZBnvLZ2vhSvLeQMRA1ejQWD93yyPF2k.resolution: The question settles from Pyth's SOL/USD price feed, read over this market's answer window. A window the feed cannot answer resolves to the source-failure outcome instead — silence is an outcome here, not a stall.
7Mcu1ZT9KZBnvLZ2vhSvLeQMRA1ejQWD93yyPF2k.story: The first market founded on dClutch's public devnet deployment: five founding stages landed in one atomic transaction on 2026-08-29. Its trading window was never switched on — the release it was founded with shipped without a route to activate trading, and the activation deadline passed while that gap was being found. Nothing was lost and nothing is hidden: its claims, its collateral, and every account it owns remain on devnet, readable forever, exactly as founding left them. This page reads them live.

CasyDFowGxqREDW5iWvKRgSMCgk5HnLQjnjegvRs.title: SOL/USD range — the orphan founding
CasyDFowGxqREDW5iWvKRgSMCgk5HnLQjnjegvRs.question: Where does the SOL/USD price finish this market's window — below its range, inside it, or above it?
CasyDFowGxqREDW5iWvKRgSMCgk5HnLQjnjegvRs.resolution: The question settles from Pyth's SOL/USD price feed, read over this market's answer window. A window the feed cannot answer resolves to the source-failure outcome instead — silence is an outcome here, not a stall.
CasyDFowGxqREDW5iWvKRgSMCgk5HnLQjnjegvRs.story: Founded shortly before the first public market, by the same tooling — and then orphaned: the driver that founded it hit a stale check and refused its own success, so the build moved on without it. It is complete and open, and its trading window, like the flagship's, was never switched on before the deadline passed. It stays in the record because devnet history is public — and so is the history of building on it.
